questions.prompt: Cutoff open-raises, button folds, small blind folds. Who is next?

choices.text: The dealer button, who already folded.

questions.explanation: Action continues in order. The big blind still has a decision.

questions.prompt: Which seat has the most postflop advantage if all three see a flop?

choices.text: The player with the most chips, regardless of seat.

questions.explanation: The button acts last on every postflop street.
